current_state.current_acceptance: OK for Stage4 internal beta (rate-limit windows are short-lived; fail-open-to-memory adapter mitigates outage impact)

options_considered.description: Current. Single redis-server on local host, no replication.
Single primary + N replicas + 3 sentinel nodes for automatic failover.
6+ node cluster with hash-slot sharding and master-replica pairs.
options_considered.selection_note: PRELIMINARY choice for broad-rollout target topology, pending production volume forecast

options_considered.description: Cloud-managed (e.g., AWS ElastiCache, GCP Memorystore, Azure Cache for Redis).
acceptable_for: all broad-rollout scenarios when budget allows
options_considered.selection_note: alternative; choose if ops capacity is limited

recommended_target.client_library: redis-py-cluster or native cluster support in redis>=5
recommended_target.key_distribution_strategy: hash tag prefix 'af2:ratelimit:' to keep related keys on same node when possible

migration_phases.phase_2_STAGING: provision 3-node cluster in staging; run V23 probe + V23 switch validation
migration_phases.phase_3_DUAL_WRITE: adapter writes to both single-node and cluster simultaneously for 24-72h, compare
migration_phases.phase_4_CUTOVER: flip AFFINITY_RATE_LIMIT_BACKEND endpoint to cluster URL, keep fail-open to memory
migration_phases.phase_5_OBSERVATION: 24-72h on cluster, replay V24 observation window
migration_phases.phase_6_DEPRECATE_SINGLE_NODE: shut down single-node redis after observation clean
migration_phases.phase_7_BROAD_ROLLOUT_PREREQ: required before any broad rollout consideration

rollback_plan.phase_4_rollback: set AFFINITY_RATE_LIMIT_BACKEND back to single-node REDIS_URL + restart
rollback_plan.data_lost_on_rollback: rate-limit window counters only (acceptable; sliding window self-heals in <1h)

hard_invariants: no broad rollout without HA in place
adapter must keep fail-open to memory on any cluster outage
no Borea data in Redis keys (only af2:ratelimit:* prefix)
